headline: Open-source Claude plugin fixes US-centric AI bias for global trade rules, now on GitHub
summary: A new open-source Claude Code plugin, "claude-trade-skills," provides country-accurate trade rules, including India GST compliance and proper regional invoice generation, eliminating US-centric defaults.
details: Many AI tools, including Claude, default to US-centric trade rules, making them unhelpful for international users dealing with specific regulations like India's GST export rules. This can lead to significant delays and financial penalties for businesses outside the US.

To address this, the "claude-trade-skills" plugin has been developed and open-sourced on GitHub. It aims to bring country-accurate trade compliance directly to AI interactions, making AI tools globally useful for commerce.

The plugin offers automated guidance for India GST compliance, including LUT (RFD-11) and ICEGATE refund error fixes, alongside Rule 89(4) ITC calculations. It ensures accuracy for complex local regulations.

It also generates commercial invoices and packing lists with correct regional identifiers, such as IEC/GSTIN for India, EORI for UK/EU, and TRN for UAE. Crucially, it avoids hallucinations by never guessing tariff codes or customs exchange rates.
caption:
Tired of AI defaulting to US trade rules? A new open-source Claude plugin brings country-accurate compliance for global commerce.

To address this, the "claude-trade-skills" plugin has been developed and open-sourced on GitHub. It aims to bring country-accurate trade compliance directly to AI interactions, making AI tools globally useful for commerce.

The plugin offers automated guidance for India GST compliance, including LUT (RFD-11) and ICEGATE refund error fixes, alongside Rule 89(4) ITC calculations. It ensures accuracy for complex local regulations.

It also generates commercial invoices and packing lists with correct regional identifiers, such as IEC/GSTIN for India, EORI for UK/EU, and TRN for UAE. Crucially, it avoids hallucinations by never guessing tariff codes or customs exchange rates.
